lines.t: Verse 1
From silence, He spoke
The oceans filled and mountains rose
Every valley carved by His breath
Life awakened from dust into flesh
Chorus
He spoke—and the dark became dawn
He called—and the void was gone
Every star burns bright with His name
All creation will sing His praise
He reigns, He reigns over all
Beginning and End, the Word of God
Light of men, breaking the night
No darkness can stand in His light
Verse 2
He hung the earth upon nothing
Stretched out the heavens in glory
Stars ignite at the sound of His voice
All creation resounds and rejoices
Chorus
He spoke—and the dark became dawn
He called—and the void was gone
Every star burns bright with His name
All creation will sing His praise
He reigns, He reigns over all
Beginning and End, the Word of God
Light of men, breaking the night
No darkness can stand in His light
Breakdown
He sees the depths we haven’t known
Every hidden thing beyond what’s shown
No distance far, no height too great
All creation rests in His gaze
Final Chorus
He spoke—and the dark became dawn
He called—and the void was gone
Every star burns bright with His name
All creation will sing His praise
He reigns, He reigns over all
Beginning and End, the Word of God
Light of men, forever alive
No darkness can stand in His light
